question_text: Read the passage: 'Public accountability requires civil servants to perform duties with utmost integrity, efficiency, and dedication. Transparency in transactions ensures citizens maintain trust in government institutions.' What is the main idea of this statement?

options.text: Civil servants should receive higher salaries to maintain integrity.
Public trust relies on accountable and transparent government service.
Government transactions must be kept confidential to avoid public scrutiny.
Efficiency is more important than integrity in public administration.

hint_ladder.title: Basahin at Tandaan ang Dalawang Ideya

hint_ladder.text: Ang tamang sagot dapat kaya i-cover ang buong passage, walang dagdag na hindi nabanggit. Kung may isang detalye lang ang nabanggit, 'di ito ang mai...

hint_ladder.title: Gamitin ang Barangay Scenario
hint_ladder.text: Isipin mo si Kapitan na nagpapaliwanag ng budget—kung bukas siya, nagtitiwala ang tao. Gano'n din dito: accountability + transparency = public trust.

hint_ladder.title: Hanapin ang Kumpletong Pahayag

next_time_rule: Kapag main idea, i-visualize mo: 'Kaya ba ng isang opsyon na i-explain ang buong passage sa kaibigan?' Kung may nakaligtaan o dinagdag, hindi 'yan ang tama.
deconstruct_text:
